# Optional Ogg Vorbis backend notices

RAVET pins vorbis_rs 0.5.6 with defaults disabled. Its Cargo archive does not
include the workspace-root bindings LICENSE; the complete upstream BSD-3-Clause
notice below was retrieved from the maintainer repository at the exact
published crate source commit 6934784e7188e98dd053370c79604c72b201e97a. Transitive vendored
codec crates contain their own complete notices, also reproduced below.

Sources:
- https://github.com/ComunidadAylas/vorbis-rs/blob/6934784e7188e98dd053370c79604c72b201e97a/LICENSE
- https://crates.io/crates/vorbis_rs/0.5.6
- https://crates.io/crates/aotuv_lancer_vorbis_sys/0.1.6
- https://crates.io/crates/ogg_next_sys/0.1.5
